_comment: Assets used by the zt_quarantine_workload playbook on Splunk SOAR 8.7 (cloud). Placeholders in angle brackets are filled by tools/soar_setup.py from local/env; never commit real values. Version pins are the apps verified on the target.

assets.name: zt_splunk
assets.description: Splunk Cloud stack, user zt-soar (role zt_soar, inherits ess_analyst): reads zt_agent_briefs_lookup and verifies DROPPED flows in index=zero_trust.

assets.name: zt_k8s_api
assets.description: Kubernetes API (emulator) at the public URL; bearer token of the zt-enforcer service account; certificate verification off (self-signed).
used_by: apply (patch data: pod labels; post data: CiliumNetworkPolicy)

assets.name: zt_hec
assets.description: Splunk HTTP Event Collector of the stack; writes zt:enforcement:audit events to index zero_trust.

assets.name: zt_hypershield
assets.description: Hypershield rules endpoint (stub on the emulator): POST /hypershield/v1/rules for the DPU enforcement point.

assets.name: zt_nexus_nxapi
assets.description: Nexus NX-API JSON-RPC endpoint (stub on the emulator): POST /ins with header X-Nexus-Device for the switch enforcement point.

assets.name: builtin_mc_connector
assets.description: Existing Enterprise Security connector asset created by the ES pairing; not created by soar_setup.py.
used_by: start_from_finding (get related investigations for finding, start investigations)
record_and_resolve (add finding or investigation note, update finding or investigation)

assets.name: phantom
assets.description: Phantom utility app asset for the no op sleeps (30 s brief polling, 15 s verification polling). Create it in the SOAR UI if it does not exist; it needs the SOAR base URL and an automation user token. Not created by soar_setup.py.

configuration.auth_token: <automation user token, created in the SOAR UI>
